title: Plexamp Playback Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plexamp:play
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by playlist_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Plexamp playback data has stopped arriving for a given playlist.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per playlist and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It calmly when one part of your Plexamp playback feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
